content.purpose: It provides shared design guidance and language-specific practices for Microsoft Agent Framework development.
content.whenToUse: Use it for applications, agents, workflows, or migrations involving Microsoft Agent Framework, including moves from Semantic Kernel or AutoGen.
content.outputs: It gives language-matched implementation recommendations based on current official documentation and samples, plus migration guidance when relevant.
